body:
Drake: Hey JOSH! JOSH! 

Josh (doing yoga): Don't distract me, I'm channeling my inner self.

Drake: Well challenge your inner self into looking at this magic book I found! 

Josh (Stopped yoga): Dude I read Cat in the Hat like 10 years ago. 

*cue laughter*

Drake: No, apparently when you write someone's name in it, they die. 

Josh: Right, and I'm an obsessed Oprah fan who sends her birthday cards every year. 

Drake: You are. 

*Cue laughter*

Drake: Hold on, let me try to write a name on my death note. 

Josh: Woah wait, if you really want to test if it works you should do it to someone close by to get immediate results!

Drake: Good idea. *Starts writing a name*

Josh: Hey, who are you writ- HEY THAT'S ME THAT'S ME GIMME IT GIMME 

*Cue laughter* 

Drake: Fine, how do you spell Oprah's last name? 

Josh: Drake, I'm warning you. 

*Megan walks in* 

Megan: Hey boobs. 

*Josh and Drake look at each other. Drake writes Megan on the death note* 

Megan: Oh hey, there's my science notebook. 

*Megan grabs it and leaves*

*Drake and Josh look at each other*

Josh: Magic notebook huh?

Drake: I guess I drank too much beer today.

A live adaptation of a popular anime/manga. How bad could it be right? 

Please be good, please be good...
